declarations.description: Accessible tooltip web component built on the browser Popover API and CSS anchor positioning.
declarations.name: JBTooltipWebComponent

attributes.name: content
attributes.description: Plain-text tooltip content. Use the content slot for rich or custom-styled content.

attributes.name: position-try-fallbacks
attributes.description: CSS position-try-fallbacks value used when the preferred placement does not fit.

attributes.name: tail
attributes.description: Shows a triangular tail on the active jb-tooltip-message.

members.name: elements
members.description: Internal element references for advanced integrations. Prefer the public methods and styling API.

members.name: positionTryFallbacks
members.description: CSS position-try-fallbacks value used when the preferred placement does not fit.

members.name: tail
members.description: Whether the active tooltip message displays a triangular tail.

members.name: open
members.description: Whether the native popover is currently open.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Opens the tooltip when it is connected and has a trigger and content.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Toggles the tooltip and returns its resulting open state.

events.name: beforetoggle
events.description: Forwarded before the native popover changes state. Canceling it prevents the change.

events.name: toggle
events.description: Forwarded after the native popover changes state.

slots.description: Tooltip trigger. The first assigned element becomes the CSS anchor and interaction target.

slots.name: content
slots.description: Rich tooltip content. Use jb-tooltip-message to opt into message sizing and tail styling.

cssParts.name: message
cssParts.description: The exported fallback jb-tooltip-message surface used by the content attribute.

cssParts.name: tail
cssParts.description: The exported fallback jb-tooltip-message tail used by the content attribute.

cssStates.name: open
cssStates.description: Applied while the native tooltip popover is open.

cssProperties.name: --jb-tooltip-max-width
cssProperties.description: Maximum width of the tooltip popover.

cssProperties.name: --jb-tooltip-gap
cssProperties.description: Space between the trigger and tooltip.

cssProperties.name: --jb-tooltip-padding
cssProperties.description: Message padding override for every size.

cssProperties.name: --jb-tooltip-font-size
cssProperties.description: Message font-size override for every size.

cssProperties.name: --jb-tooltip-border-radius
cssProperties.description: Message border-radius override for every size.

cssProperties.name: --jb-tooltip-bg-color
cssProperties.description: Message background color.

cssProperties.name: --jb-tooltip-text-color
cssProperties.description: Message text color.

cssProperties.name: --jb-tooltip-border
cssProperties.description: Message border shorthand.

cssProperties.name: --jb-tooltip-box-shadow
cssProperties.description: Message box shadow.

cssProperties.name: --jb-tooltip-tail-size
cssProperties.description: Tail size override for every message size.

cssProperties.name: --jb-tooltip-tail-bg-color
cssProperties.description: Tail fill color.

cssProperties.name: --jb-tooltip-tail-border-color
cssProperties.description: Tail border color.

cssProperties.name: --jb-tooltip-tail-border-width
cssProperties.description: Tail border width.
